SELECT food_code AS code, food_name AS name, category, weight, energy_kcal AS energyKcal, protein_g AS proteinG, fat_g AS fatG, carbohydrate_g AS carbohydrateG FROM food_nutrition
WHERE food_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN food_name LIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CHAR_LENGTH(food_name), food_name
ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(food_name), food_name
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT food_code AS code, food_name AS name, category, weight, energy_kcal AS energyKcal, protein_g AS proteinG, fat_g AS fatG, carbohydrate_g AS carbohydrateG FROM food_nutrition WHERE food_code = #{foodCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_logs (user_id, log_type, meal_type, eaten_at, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, 'CONSUMED', #{mealType}, #{eatenAt}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT meal_log_id AS id, user_id AS userId, meal_type AS mealType, eaten_at AS eatenAt, memo, created_at AS createdAt FROM meal_logs WHERE meal_log_id = #{mealLogId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND log_type = 'CONSUMED'

SELECT i.meal_log_item_id AS id, i.meal_log_id AS mealLogId, i.food_code AS foodCode, i.item_name AS name, i.quantity, i.quantity_unit AS unit, f.energy_kcal AS energyKcal, f.protein_g AS proteinG, f.carbohydrate_g AS carbohydrateG, f.fat_g AS fatG FROM meal_log_items i LEFT JOIN food_nutrition f ON f.food_code = i.food_code WHERE i.meal_log_id = #{mealLogId} AND i.item_type = 'CONSUMED' ORDER BY i.meal_log_item_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.meal_log_id) AS mealCount, COUNT(i.meal_log_item_id) AS itemCount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.energy_kcal, 0) * i.quantity), 0) AS totalCalories, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.protein_g, 0) * i.quantity), 0) AS totalProtein, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.carbohydrate_g, 0) * i.quantity), 0) AS totalCarbohydrate, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.fat_g, 0) * i.quantity), 0) AS totalFat FROM meal_logs l LEFT JOIN meal_log_items i ON i.meal_log_id = l.meal_log_id AND i.item_type = 'CONSUMED' LEFT JOIN food_nutrition f ON f.food_code = i.food_code WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.log_type = 'CONSUMED' AND DATE(l.eaten_at) = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_logs (user_id, log_type, meal_type, eaten_at, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, 'RECOMMENDATION', NULL, NULL, 'AI 레시피 추천')
mapper.select: SELECT meal_log_id FROM meal_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND log_type = 'RECOMMENDATION' ORDER BY created_at DESC, meal_log_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.meal_log_item_id AS id, i.meal_log_id AS mealLogId, i.item_name AS name, i.quantity, i.quantity_unit AS unit, i.recipe_payload AS recipePayload FROM meal_log_items i JOIN meal_logs l ON l.meal_log_id = i.meal_log_id WHERE i.meal_log_id = #{mealLogId} AND l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.log_type = 'RECOMMENDATION' AND i.item_type = 'RECOMMENDATION' ORDER BY i.meal_log_item_id
